Review Spaceship?

Reviews of Spaceship are sharply mixed. Fans praise its sleek, futuristic UI, smooth onboarding, and strong value, often calling out fast, helpful support and a satisfying “unboxing” feel. Several users say email and domain management work well once set up. Detractors report serious pain points: unreliable or unfinished APIs, promo code and VPN false-flag issues, confusing nameserver changes, registry/KYC delays, and harsh fraud/abuse enforcement leading to cancellations without refunds. Overall, an appealing, low-cost option with standout design but inconsistent reliability and policy frictions.

Hey Product Hunt, I'm Michael, founder of Spacesheep (YC F26).

Agentic output is growing, while our ability to read remains the same.

With Spacesheep you can turn any agentic output into a visual space. Share it with colleagues, comment on the exact line, or add an integration and stream live data into it (see examples below).

How it works:  
1. Ask the AI you already use: "Use spacesheep.dev and give a visual explanation of how GPUs work."  
2. You get a space: a document, a mockup, a dashboard, an app or art.  
3. Share it with specific people, your team, or publicly. Write @​spacesheep in a comment, and the AI fixes the space while everyone watches. Every version is kept. [...] It works with any agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok, Grok Build and open-source harnesses like opencode. Or use Spacesheep's own AI on the dashboard, in Slack and more. Every space syncs to your own Google Drive or GitHub.
